entities.summary: Ahmed Ismail El Shamy is an Egyptian boxer who competed in the Men's Light Heavyweight at the 2004 Summer Olympics and won the bronze medal. One year earlier, he won the gold medal in his weight division at the All-Africa Games as well as a bronze medal at the 1999 All-Africa Games.
